title: Nova Scotia Appliance Rebates 2026: Heat Pump Dryers and Instant Rebates
desc: Nova Scotia has no fridge or washer rebate in 2026, but Efficiency Nova Scotia takes $150 off a heat pump dryer at checkout. The full instant rebate list and how to claim.
badge: $150 off a heat pump dryer at checkout
lead: Nova Scotia does not pay a rebate on refrigerators, dishwashers or washing machines. What it does pay is a short list of instant rebates taken off at the till: $150 for a heat pump clothes dryer, $200 for a variable-speed pool pump, $800 for a heat pump water heater and a few small ones. Here is the whole list as of October 5, 2026.
cards_heading: What we found for Nova Scotia appliances
cards_intro: We read the Efficiency Nova Scotia Instant Rebates page in full on October 5, 2026. It shows no end date.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: ENERGY STAR heat pump dryer, instant rebate at participating retailers. These dryers are vent-free and use gentle, low-temperature drying.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: Instant in-store at checkout. The same $800 can come through an assessment if you did not take it at the till, but not both.

cards.title: Smart thermostat for electric heat
cards.note: At participating retailers, or online at getmysa.com. Only for thermostats made for electric heating.

cards.title: Variable-speed pool pump
cards.note: ENERGY STAR certified, instant in-store rebate.

cards.title: Clothesline kit or outside dryer
cards.note: Five dollars off at participating retailers. Small, but the cheapest way to cut a dryer bill.

cards.title: Free smart thermostat
cards.note: Electrically heated homes on a residential rate can have one installed at no cost, with other free devices possible.

after_cards: Refrigerators, freezers, dishwashers, washers and air conditioners are not on the list, so a store sign that promises a Nova Scotia rebate on one of them is not an Efficiency Nova Scotia offer.
sections: The dryer is the one to watch

A heat pump dryer does not vent hot air outdoors. It dries clothes at a lower temperature using a heat pump, which is why Efficiency Nova Scotia describes it as saving money on energy bills and gentle on clothes. Nova Scotia Power charges 19.128 cents per kWh plus a $20.08 monthly base charge since May 1, 2026, so every kilowatt hour a dryer saves is worth about 19 cents to you. The $150 off the price does not change what the unit costs to run, so compare the model's rated energy use and the price before you buy.
Read the eligible model list first

Each instant rebate has an eligible model list on the Efficiency Nova Scotia page. The rebate only comes off when the model is on the list and the store is a participating retailer, so check both before you go. The page also has a map to find participating stores. If a store has never heard of the rebate, ask at the desk before you pay, because the discount is applied at checkout, not mailed to you afterwards.

The biggest appliance-type rebate is $800 on an ENERGY STAR certified heat pump water heater. Take it at the till and you cannot also claim the same $800 through an assessment. See our Halifax water heater page or the Cape Breton one for the rules on picking a model.

The federal Canada Greener Homes Grant ended, with its last day for documents on December 31, 2025. Its loan cannot approve new applications. Efficiency Nova Scotia's Home Heating System Rebates also closed on December 31, 2025. What remains for appliances is the instant list above.

Instant rebates are at the till, so renters can use them on an appliance they buy. The free thermostat visit needs the landlord's written permission, and the $400 provincial heating rebate is open to renters who pay their own heat. Electricity use under 5,000 kWh a year does not count as an eligible heating cost for that rebate, and heat included in your rent does not count either.
claim_heading: How to get the instant rebate
claim_steps: Pick the product and check the eligible model list on the Efficiency Nova Scotia page.
Use the retailer map to find a participating store.
Ask for the instant rebate at checkout and check it shows on your receipt.
Keep the receipt in case a question comes up later.
For a thermostat, you can also buy online at getmysa.com.
faq: Does Nova Scotia have a refrigerator or washer rebate?
Not that we found. The instant rebate list covers heat pump dryers, heat pump water heaters, pool pumps, thermostats and clotheslines.
How much is the heat pump dryer rebate?
$150, taken off at checkout at participating retailers for an ENERGY STAR heat pump dryer.
Can I stack the $800 water heater rebate?
Not twice. The instant rebate and the assessment rebate are the same $800, so you take one.
Is the instant rebate list permanent?
The page shows no end date, but Efficiency Nova Scotia updates it, so check before you buy.
